about_the_game:
Remnants of Eden is an isometric sci-fi survival game set in a vengeful mechanical world haunted by memory and loss.
You play as Elias Kael, a scientist trapped in an endless cycle of grief after losing his daughter. Each procedurally generated level represents a stage of that grief — an unpredictable maze of broken technology, radiation, and hostile machines that aim to destroy everything you have built.

Scavenge resources, outsmart drones, turrets, modified androids and endure the toxic air as you try to escape a vicious world meant to destroy every inch of your soul. Find weapons, choose wisely as a human, since you’re vulnerable to radiation, unfamiliar with weapons, but resourceful, since you can interact with everything around you.

As a machine, you’re immune to hazards but slowly poisoned by your own existence. Much better with weapons, but unable to reach that far. Every escape leads you back to the start — a looping nightmare where the world changes, but the pain remains.

Survive long enough, and the fragments of a forgotten soul begin to surface — not to be saved, but to be understood.
What will you sacrifice to remember what was lost?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit (1909.1350+) or Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 3 3100 (4+ cores)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 / AMD RX 590 (≈6–8 GB VRAM, DX12)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit (1909.1350+) or Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700K / AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2070 Super / RTX 3060 Ti, or AMD RX 6700 XT (8–12 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: Remnants of Eden is an isometric sci-fi survival game where you switch between human and machine forms to endure radiation, fight rogue androids, drones, and turrets, and scavenge scarce resources across 20 looping levels of grief above the clouds
